title: Murnan Auto LS Swap Ultimate -6AN PTFE Fuel Line & Billet Filter Kit
description:
The ultimate all-in-one fuel line and filtration solution engineered for LS engine swaps. 🇺🇸 100% Made in Florida with Premium American Materials.

⚠️ Note: This kit includes all lines, fittings, adapters, and the inline filter assembly. Fuel pressure regulator and fuel pump are not included (complete fuel system packages coming soon!).

Rated for builds up to 650+ HP on pump gas or E85, this kit pairs ultra-flexible -6AN nylon-braided PTFE hose with heavy-duty metal-insert quick disconnects and an oversized -10ORB billet filter housing for maximum flow and zero fuel odor permeation.

Designed specifically to eliminate line restriction and simplify routing through tight engine bays, headers, and steering shafts.

Key Features:
🇺🇸 American-Made Quality: Precision machined and manufactured in Florida using USA-sourced materials for total reliability under high pressure.

Zero Fuel Permeation: Premium PTFE inner lining stops E85 and race fuel vapors from permeating into your garage or cabin.

Metal-Insert Quick Disconnects: Heavy-duty billet aluminum retaining inserts replace brittle factory plastic clips that crack over time.

Oversized -10ORB Filtration: Features a massive billet filter housing adapted down to -6AN, providing maximum filtration surface area, reduced pressure drop, and extended service intervals.

Swept Angle Builder Package: Includes 120° swept bend hose ends alongside standard 90° and straight fittings to navigate tight firewalls and frame rails smoothly.

What's in the Box:
(1x) -6AN to 3/8" Female EFI Quick Connect (Metal Insert)

(1x) -6AN to 5/16" Female EFI Quick Connect (Metal Insert)

(2x) -10 ORB to -6AN Straight Adapters

(4x) PTFE Hose End – Straight -6AN

(4x) PTFE Hose End – 90 Degree -6AN

(1x) PTFE Hose End – 120 Degree -6AN

(1x) -6AN Nylon Braided PTFE Fuel Hose (20 Foot Roll)

(1x) High-Flow Billet Inline Fuel Filter Housing

(1x) 10-Micron Cleanable Stainless Steel Filter Element (E85/Gasoline)

(1x) Billet Fuel Filter Mounting Bracket
